description: Carbene/metallacyclobutane mechanism of alkene metathesis (Chauvin, Schrock, Grubbs Nobel 2005)

name: Hammett Linear Free Energy
description: Substituent effect on rate; sign and magnitude of rho diagnose charge buildup at the transition state

name: Eyring Equation
description: Transition-state theory rate constant; Eyring plot extracts activation enthalpy and entropy

name: Molecular (Coulomb) Hamiltonian
description: Full non-relativistic electronic-nuclear Hamiltonian; the 1/r_ij term is what makes exact solution impossible

name: Slater Determinant
description: Antisymmetric N-electron wavefunction built from spin-orbitals; enforces the Pauli principle by construction

name: Variational Principle
description: Any trial wavefunction's energy expectation is an upper bound on the true ground-state energy

name: Fock Operator
description: Effective one-electron HF operator: core Hamiltonian plus Coulomb (J) and exchange (K) terms from occupied orbitals

name: Roothaan-Hall Equations
description: Matrix form of Hartree-Fock in a finite basis; generalized eigenvalue problem solved iteratively (SCF)

name: Gaussian-Type Orbital
expression: \chi^\text{GTO}(\mathbf{r}) = N x^{l_x} y^{l_y} z^{l_z} e^{-\alpha r^2}
description: Gaussian primitive used as basis function; products on different centers are themselves Gaussians (Boys 1950)

name: Helgaker CBS Extrapolation
description: Power-law extrapolation of correlation energy from cc-pVnZ sequence to the complete basis set limit

name: MP2 Correlation Energy
description: Second-order Moller-Plesset correlation correction; recovers 80-90% of correlation at O(N^5) cost

name: Coupled-Cluster Exponential Ansatz
description: Size-consistent expansion underlying CCSD/CCSD(T), the gold standard of single-reference quantum chemistry

name: Hohenberg-Kohn Energy Functional
description: Universal DFT energy functional of the electron density; minimized at the true ground-state density

name: Kohn-Sham Equations
description: One-electron orbital equations of a fictitious non-interacting system reproducing the real density

name: Hybrid Exchange-Correlation Functional
description: Mixes a fraction of exact HF exchange with DFT exchange-correlation; B3LYP uses a = 0.20

name: Larmor Frequency
description: Nuclear precession frequency in field B0; sets the resonance frequency of an NMR experiment

name: Chemical Shift (ppm)
description: Field-independent chemical shift relative to a reference (TMS for 1H/13C)

name: Karplus Relation
description: Vicinal H-H coupling constant as a function of dihedral angle; lets you read torsions off a 1H spectrum

name: T2 Linewidth Relation
description: Natural NMR linewidth set by the spin-spin (transverse) relaxation time T2

name: NOE Distance Dependence
description: Through-space dipolar cross-relaxation; r^-6 scaling makes NOESY a 5 A distance ruler

name: Magic Angle
description: Spinning angle that nulls (3cos^2 theta - 1), removing CSA and dipolar broadening in solid-state NMR

name: Vibrational Frequency (Harmonic Oscillator)
description: IR/Raman normal-mode wavenumber from force constant k and reduced mass mu

name: SERS |E|^4 Enhancement

name: Multiply Charged ESI Ion
description: Mass-to-charge of multiply protonated ions in electrospray ionization

name: Mass Resolving Power

name: ICR Cyclotron Frequency

name: EPR Resonance Condition
description: Electron Zeeman splitting; g-factor reports orbital character (g_e = 2.0023 for free electron)

name: XPS Photoelectric Equation

name: EXAFS Equation
description: Photoelectron interference oscillations above the absorption edge; FT yields neighbor distances and coordination numbers

name: DNMT1 Maintenance Fidelity

name: Motif Information Content
description: Total information (in bits) of a transcription factor binding motif from a position weight matrix

name: Expected Motif Occurrences

name: Incoherent Feed-Forward Loop ODE

name: HMM Forward-Backward Posterior

description: Genome-wide depletion ratio of CpG dinucleotides caused by spontaneous deamination of 5-methylcytosine to thymine over evolutionary time

name: Knudson Two-Hit Probability
description: Knudson's two-hit hypothesis: hereditary cases scale linearly with mutation rate p while sporadic cases require both alleles to be hit

name: Somatic Mutation Rate
description: Baseline per-base per-division mutation rate of normal cells versus the elevated rate in cancers with a mutator phenotype

name: Metastatic Colonization Probability
description: Approximate probability that a single circulating tumor cell survives the metastatic cascade to seed a clinically detectable metastasis

name: Tumor Mutational Burden
description: Per-megabase mutation density used to predict checkpoint inhibitor response and as a tissue-agnostic FDA biomarker

name: Hill Equation (Drug-Receptor)
description: Sigmoidal dose-response curve relating drug concentration to fractional receptor occupancy with Hill coefficient n

name: Screening ROC Trade-off
description: True positive rate versus false positive rate trade-off that governs cancer screening sensitivity vs overdiagnosis

name: RBS Calculator Free Energy
expression: \Delta G_{\text{total}} = \Delta G_{\text{mRNA-rRNA}} + \Delta G_{\text{spacing}} + \Delta G_{\text{standby}} - \Delta G_{\text{mRNA fold}}

name: Hill Repression Function

name: Repressilator ODE
description: Elowitz-Leibler equations for the three-repressor cyclic oscillator that produces sustained transcriptional oscillations

name: Flux Balance Analysis LP

description: Linear program maximizing a metabolic objective (biomass or product) under steady-state mass balance and reaction bounds

name: Toggle Switch Bistability
description: Gardner-Cantor-Collins ODEs for two mutually repressing genes producing a bistable genetic memory element

name: Containment Escape Probability
description: Approximate ceiling on per-cell escape probability when combining recoded chassis, auxotrophy, and kill switches

name: Langmuir Adsorption Kinetics
description: Time-dependent surface coverage of adsorbed protein approaching equilibrium with rate constant k_ads

name: Bone-Implant Stiffness Mismatch
description: Elastic modulus mismatch driving stress shielding around metallic orthopaedic implants

name: Magnesium Bioresorption Reaction
description: Hydrolytic corrosion reaction by which bioresorbable magnesium implants dissolve in physiological fluid

name: Hydroxyapatite Stoichiometry
description: Composition of stoichiometric hydroxyapatite, the principal mineral of bone and the canonical osteoconductive ceramic

name: Young's Equation
description: Equilibrium contact angle of a liquid drop on a solid in terms of solid-vapor, solid-liquid, and liquid-vapor surface tensions

name: Flory-Rehner Rubber Elasticity

name: Higuchi Release Equation
description: Cumulative drug release per area from a planar matrix under Fickian diffusion, scaling as the square root of time

name: Korsmeyer-Peppas Power Law

name: Surface-to-Volume Ratio (Sphere)
description: Inverse-radius scaling of surface-to-volume ratio that diverges as particles shrink to the nanoscale

name: Brus Equation
description: Size-dependent bandgap of a spherical semiconductor quantum dot combining particle-in-a-box confinement and Coulomb attraction

name: Particle-in-a-Box Confinement Energy
description: Ground-state confinement energy for a carrier of effective mass m* trapped in a box of size L

name: Gibbs-Thomson Equation
description: Excess chemical potential of a small particle that drives Ostwald ripening and elevated solubility at the nanoscale

name: Nucleation Free Energy
description: Classical nucleation balance between bulk free-energy gain and surface-energy cost during crystal nucleation

name: Graphene Dirac Dispersion
description: Linear (massless Dirac) energy-momentum relation for electrons near the K-points of graphene

name: Carbon Nanotube Diameter
description: Diameter of a single-walled carbon nanotube as a function of its chiral indices (n, m)

name: CNT Metallicity Selection Rule
description: Chirality rule determining whether a single-walled carbon nanotube is metallic or semiconducting

name: Plasmon Resonance Condition
description: Localized surface plasmon resonance frequency of a small Drude-metal sphere in a dielectric medium

name: Quasistatic Absorption Cross-Section
description: Absorption cross-section of a small metal sphere from quasistatic Mie theory, peaking at the plasmon resonance

name: SERS Enhancement
description: Electromagnetic Raman enhancement at a plasmonic hotspot scaling as the fourth power of the local field

name: Néel-Arrhenius Relaxation

name: Superparamagnetic Blocking Temperature

name: Percolation Threshold (Rods)

name: Percolation Conductivity Scaling
description: Power-law rise of bulk conductivity above the percolation threshold with universal exponent t in three dimensions

name: Lithography Resolution Limit
description: Rayleigh resolution scaling for projection photolithography that sets feature size at advanced semiconductor nodes

name: Tunneling Current (STM)
description: Exponential dependence of scanning tunneling microscope current on tip-sample gap that yields sub-Ångström resolution

name: Electron Wavelength (TEM)

name: HAADF Z-Contrast

name: CI Enrichment Factor
description: Si-normalised enrichment of element X in a sample relative to CI chondrite

name: Lattice Strain Partitioning

name: Bulk Partition Coefficient
description: Modal-weighted sum of mineral/melt partition coefficients across a polymineralic source

name: Batch (Equilibrium) Melting
description: Trace element concentration in melt for batch partial melting at melt fraction F

name: Fractional Melting
description: Trace element concentration in instantaneous melt during fractional (Rayleigh) melting

name: Eu Anomaly
description: Magnitude of the Eu anomaly relative to interpolated Sm-Gd baseline (chondrite-normalised)

name: Radioactive Decay Law
description: First-order decay of a radioactive parent and half-life relation

name: Rb-Sr Isochron
description: Isochron equation for cogenetic minerals with shared initial daughter ratio

name: Dodson Closure Temperature
description: Dodson (1973) closure temperature for diffusive loss of a daughter from a mineral

name: Wetherill Concordia
description: Two coupled U-Pb daughter/parent ratios that trace out the Wetherill concordia

name: Pb-Pb Age Equation
description: Pb-Pb daughter ratio as a function of age, independent of U content

name: Delta Notation
description: Per-mil deviation of a heavy/light isotope ratio from an international standard

name: Calcite-Water Oxygen Thermometer
description: Kim and O'Neil (1997) equilibrium oxygen fractionation between calcite and water (T in K)

name: Cosmogenic Build-up
description: Accumulation of an in-situ cosmogenic nuclide produced at rate P with decay constant lambda

name: Cosmogenic Steady State with Erosion
description: Steady-state cosmogenic concentration under erosion rate epsilon and attenuation length Lambda

name: Epsilon Nd
description: Sample 143Nd/144Nd deviation from CHUR in parts per 10,000

name: Hf-W Extinct Chronometer
description: Short-lived chronometer used to date metal-silicate differentiation in the early solar system

name: Triple-Oxygen MIF
description: Mass-independent fractionation anomaly in three-isotope oxygen systems

name: Clumped Isotope Excess
description: Excess of mass-47 carbonate isotopologues above the random distribution; a temperature proxy

name: Entropy Balance for Life
description: Schrodinger's framing: organisms maintain order by exporting entropy to the environment

name: Stellar Flux at a Planet
description: Insolation a planet receives in Earth-flux units, given stellar luminosity and orbital distance

name: Habitable Zone Distance
description: Distance at which a planet receives Earth-equivalent insolation from a star of luminosity L

name: Serpentinization Reaction
description: Reaction of olivine with water that releases hydrogen and powers alkaline vent chemistry

name: Methanogenesis Energy Couple
description: Energy-yielding reduction of CO2 by H2 used by methanogens and proposed as ancient autotrophy

name: Biological Carbon Isotope Signature
description: Carbon isotope ratio used to identify biological fractionation (typically -25 per mil for photosynthesis)

name: Transit Depth (Geometric)
description: Fractional dimming of starlight when a planet of radius R_p transits a star of radius R_star

name: Atmospheric Annulus Transit Depth

name: Drake Equation

name: Atmospheric Scale Height
description: Vertical e-folding height of an atmosphere; sets the size of the transmission spectroscopy signal

name: Newton's Second Law
description: Net force equals mass times acceleration, equivalently the time derivative of momentum

name: Linear Momentum
description: Momentum of a particle of mass m moving with velocity v

name: Kinetic Energy
description: Translational kinetic energy of a particle

name: Gravitational Potential Energy
description: Potential energy of two point masses separated by distance r

name: Angular Momentum
description: Angular momentum about a point, equal to moment of inertia times angular velocity for rigid bodies

name: Euler-Lagrange Equation
description: Equations of motion derived from a Lagrangian L=T-U for generalized coordinates q_i

name: First Law of Thermodynamics
description: Change in internal energy equals heat absorbed minus work done by the system

name: Second Law (Clausius)
description: Entropy of a closed system never decreases; equality holds for reversible processes

name: Ideal Gas Law
description: Equation of state for an ideal gas with n moles at pressure P, volume V, temperature T

name: Boltzmann Entropy
description: Entropy as the logarithm of the number of accessible microstates

name: Gibbs Free Energy
expression: G = U + PV - TS = H - TS
description: Thermodynamic potential whose minimization governs equilibrium at constant T and P

name: Maxwell Relation (G)
description: Maxwell relation derived from the exactness of dG = -S dT + V dP

name: Gauss's Law
description: Divergence of the electric field equals charge density over the permittivity of free space

name: Gauss's Law for Magnetism
description: No magnetic monopoles: magnetic field lines have zero divergence

name: Faraday's Law
description: A time-varying magnetic field induces a curling electric field

name: Ampere-Maxwell Law
description: Magnetic field curls around currents and time-varying electric fields

name: Lorentz Force
description: Force on a charge q moving with velocity v through electric and magnetic fields

name: Poynting Vector
description: Energy flux density of the electromagnetic field

name: Electromagnetic Wave Equation
description: Wave equation in vacuum derived from Maxwell's equations; wave speed c = 1/sqrt(mu0 eps0)

name: Time-Dependent Schrodinger Equation
description: Evolution of a quantum state under the Hamiltonian operator H

name: Time-Independent Schrodinger Equation
description: Eigenvalue equation for stationary states of energy E

name: Heisenberg Uncertainty
description: Lower bound on the product of position and momentum uncertainties

name: Expectation Value
description: Mean value of observable A in state psi

name: Canonical Commutator
description: Fundamental commutation relation between position and momentum operators

name: de Broglie Wavelength
description: Wavelength associated with a particle of momentum p

name: Lorentz Factor
description: Dilation factor relating proper and observer-frame quantities at relative velocity v

name: Lorentz Transformation
description: Boost transformation between two inertial frames moving at velocity v along x

name: Time Dilation
description: Coordinate time interval is gamma times the proper time interval of a moving clock

name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
description: Rest energy of a particle of mass m

name: Energy-Momentum Relation
description: Relativistic dispersion relation linking energy, momentum, and rest mass

name: Four-Momentum
description: Lorentz-covariant four-momentum whose invariant magnitude is the rest mass

name: Gibbs Free Energy Change
description: Spontaneity criterion at constant T and P: a process proceeds if Delta G < 0

name: Equilibrium Constant from Free Energy
description: Standard free energy change related to the thermodynamic equilibrium constant K

name: Arrhenius Equation
description: Temperature dependence of a rate constant via activation energy E_a

name: Eyring Equation
description: Transition-state theory rate constant in terms of activation free energy

name: Nernst Equation
description: Cell potential as a function of reaction quotient Q at temperature T

name: Clausius-Clapeyron Equation
description: Slope of a liquid-vapor coexistence curve in pressure-temperature space

name: Michaelis-Menten Rate
description: Initial reaction velocity of an enzyme as a function of substrate concentration

name: Lineweaver-Burk Linearization
description: Double-reciprocal plot used to extract K_M and V_max from kinetic data

name: Catalytic Efficiency
description: Specificity constant comparing efficiency of enzymes for different substrates

name: Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation
description: Buffer pH from the ratio of conjugate base to weak acid

name: Gibbs Free Energy of an ATP Hydrolysis
description: Cellular free energy of ATP hydrolysis at given metabolite concentrations

name: Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium
description: Genotype frequencies under random mating with no selection, mutation, or drift

name: Allele Frequency Sum
description: Allele frequencies of a biallelic locus must sum to one

name: Recombination Frequency
description: Fraction of offspring showing crossover between two loci; 1 cM = 1 percent recombination

name: Haldane Mapping Function
description: Relates recombination frequency r to genetic distance d (Morgans) assuming no interference

name: Inbreeding-Adjusted Genotype Frequencies
expression: f(AA) = p^2 + Fpq, \quad f(Aa) = 2pq(1-F), \quad f(aa) = q^2 + Fpq
description: Genotype frequencies under inbreeding coefficient F
